title: Tool output events drop backend correlation_id
reasoning: The normalizer preserves payload.correlation_id for tool-call events, but tool-output events set correlationId from payload.request_id and ignore payload.correlation_id. When the backend sends a distinct correlation_id, the SDK emits a tool_output event that cannot be matched to the corresponding tool_call by the shared correlation id, which can break UI grouping, pending-tool resolution, and replay logic.
reproduction: Send a backend tool-call event with payload.correlation_id set to one value and request_id set to another, then send a matching tool-output event carrying the same correlation_id. The normalized tool_call has correlationId from correlation_id, while the normalized tool_output has correlationId from request_id.
recommendation: For tool-output, prefer payload.correlation_id when it is a string, falling back to payload.request_id only if needed. Apply the same rule to any progress events that are intended to correlate with tool calls.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for this feature, and the excerpt does not show a regression test asserting correlation id preservation across tool-call and tool-output normalization.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a backendEventNormalizer test that normalizes a tool-call and tool-output with both request_id and correlation_id present and asserts both ConversationEvents expose the same correlationId from payload.correlation_id.
minimumFixScope: Update the tool-output correlationId mapping in backendEventNormalizer.ts and add focused SDK normalizer coverage.
